fact: The proposed US$52 million build-operate-transfer concession with OeSD International, signed in April 2026 and sent to the Legislature on 15 July 2026, would place development and operation of the national ID infrastructure with a foreign concessionaire, with local firms asking when operational authority will pass to Liberian staff.
title: Concerns Mount Over NIR US$52M Biometric ID Concession -Jeopardizing Jobs, Data And Revenue Security?
